meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 它会先复现你报的缺陷,在临时工作区写出最小修复并跑测试验证,再交付:上游 openai/codex 的 bug 提 fork PR;LazyCodex 自身的缺陷只在 code-yeongyu/lazycodex 提内嵌补丁的 issue,不开 PR。
howto.when: 当你要求修一个 bug、贡献 bug 修复,或调试 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷时接管;它会先判断缺陷属于哪个仓库,再决定交付方式。

say.text: 帮我修这个 LazyCodex 的 bug,附上复现日志和补丁
say.note: 会产出带补丁的验证修复 issue

say.text: 这个 Codex CLI 的 bug 能复现,帮我提个 fork PR
say.note: 会从 fork 推送分支并开 PR

say.text: 先调试这个缺陷,确认根因,再给出验证过的修复
say.note: 会先定位根因再做最小改动

howto.what_en: It reproduces the bug you report, writes the smallest correct fix in a temporary workspace and tests it, then delivers: a fork PR for upstream openai/codex bugs, or an issue with the embedded patch for LazyCodex-owned defects (never a PR).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, open a PR for a bug, or debug a LazyCodex/Codex defect. It first decides which repo owns the defect, then picks the delivery form.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and attach the repro logs and patch
say_en.note: Produces a verified-fix issue with the patch

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces; open a fork PR for it
say_en.note: Pushes a fork branch and opens the PR

say_en.text: Debug this defect, confirm the root cause, then give a verified fix
say_en.note: Locates the root cause before the minimal change
